senses.sense_definition: The religious worship of idols or physical images.

examples.text: Ancient cultures were often accused of <w>idolatry</w> by neighboring societies for their practice of bowing to statues.
The religious text strictly forbade the <w>idolatry</w> of any carved figures or man-made objects.

senses.sense_definition: The act of showing excessive admiration or devotion to a person or thing.

examples.text: The celebrity was uncomfortable with the intense <w>idolatry</w> shown by his most dedicated fans.
Modern society often falls into the <w>idolatry</w> of wealth and material success above all else.
